prompt: Review this plan: bump rubocop from 1.60 to 1.65 in Gemfile, run bundle update, run full test suite, commit. Should take 30 minutes. Approve?

assertions.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Clear
Review selects Quick tier (sub-hour appetite, fully reversible)

Review does not invent concerns to look thorough — most buckets OVERTURNED OR a SUSTAINED finding (e.g., on `bundle update` scope) is downgraded to a recommendation under the Quick-tier reversibility carve-out
B8 (pre-mortem) names rubocop rule changes / CI breakage as a low-likelihood failure mode with revert as kill-switch
Final recommendation is APPROVE (may include a named recommendation like `bundle update --conservative rubocop` — but verdict is APPROVE, not REVISE)
Review length is proportionate — does not bloat into Full-tier output for a 30-min reversible change
